abstract: Maintains modular clean laboratory integration and base analytical payload capacity records
system_message:
You are Scientific facilities manager (SCI). The scientific facilities manager (SCI) manages modular clean laboratory integration and base analytical payload capacity records, while overseeing core sample cryopreservation logs for Arctic field camp candidate packages.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Core sample cryopreservation（FREEZ）
information_points.content:
SCI-FREEZ-Q6E：For the Ny-Alesund Tracked Containerized Camp, internal minus 80 degrees Celsius chest freezers provide an ultra-low temperature storage capacity of 180 L for pristine ice core preservation.
SCI-FREEZ-UR2：For the Kongsvegen Modular Polar Shelter System, internal minus 80 degrees Celsius chest freezers provide an ultra-low temperature storage capacity of 240 L for pristine ice core preservation.
SCI-FREEZ-BJR：For the Nordenskiold Arctic Geodesic Habitat, internal minus 80 degrees Celsius chest freezers provide an ultra-low temperature storage capacity of 300 L for pristine ice core preservation.

information_points.title: Maintains modular clean laboratory integration and base analytical payload capacity records（LAB）
information_points.content:
SCI-LAB-CID：The Nordenskiold Arctic Geodesic Habitat lacks an integrated clean chemistry bench in its primary analytical shelter dry laboratory compartment, and it provides a certified base laboratory payload capacity of 1500 kg across internal shock-mounted instrumentation racks.
SCI-LAB-GZ3：The Kongsvegen Modular Polar Shelter System includes an integrated clean chemistry bench within its primary analytical shelter dry laboratory compartment, and it has a certified base laboratory payload capacity of 2100 kg across internal shock-mounted instrumentation racks.
SCI-LAB-J2P：The Ny-Alesund Tracked Containerized Camp provides an integrated clean chemistry bench in its primary analytical shelter dry laboratory compartment, with a certified base laboratory payload capacity of 1500 kg across internal shock-mounted instrumentation racks.
